concepts.name: Theory Of Consumer Behaviour 1 Unit Intr
concepts.simple_definition: Unit 1: Theory of Consumer Behaviour 1 Unit Introduction A consumer is a decision making unit (an individual or a household) who uses or consumes a commodity or service
concepts.deep_explanation: The theory of consumer behavior is concerned with how a consumer decides on the basket of goods and services he/she consumes in order to maximize his/her satisfaction
